title: Chesstories judgment evaluation common types v1
$comment: The experiment source/arm is deliberately not part of a stage document. It belongs to runner/capture metadata so an adapter cannot leak assignment through the stage interface.

x-canonical-annotation-registry.identity-definition: Defines an ID in the named namespace. Canonical re-ID must update every matching reference.
x-canonical-annotation-registry.identity-reference: A scalar reference into the named identity namespace.
x-canonical-annotation-registry.identity-reference-set: An unordered array of references into the named identity namespace.
x-canonical-annotation-registry.unordered-set: Array order has no meaning. Values remain otherwise byte-for-byte significant.
x-canonical-annotation-registry.null-equivalent-omission: Only a JSON null at this annotated property is equivalent to omitting the property.
x-canonical-annotation-registry.forbidden: Confidence values, ranked-list order/rank values, and operational missingness have no canonicalization annotation.

x-semantic-transition-registry.envelope: input payload/hash and the exact committed upstream artifact-hash set; output echoes the validated input envelope
x-semantic-transition-registry.reference_closure: identity-definition and identity-reference annotations define all namespace closure; duplicate definitions and dangling references are forbidden

stage_relations.Ja: each decision is an unchanged member of Jp proposals
stage_relations.R: each ranked claim is an unchanged admitted Ja decision and ranks are unique
stage_relations.P: public claims and materialized support are unchanged subsets of the direct P input

mate_in.$comment: Signed plies from the declared perspective: positive means that side can force mate, negative means that side is being mated.

forced_required_lines.$comment: These are independently forced searchmoves acquisitions, never ranked MultiPV cells.

candidate_lines.$comment: Array order and multipv_index are ranking semantics and are intentionally not canonicalizable.

forced_required_lines.$comment: Lines acquired with UCI searchmoves to cover a requested move. They carry no MultiPV rank semantics.

repetitions.$comment: Repetition order is retained because it participates in stability diagnostics.

missing_evidence.$comment: Operational missingness and its ordering are preserved exactly.

delta_centipawns.$comment: played_evaluation minus reference_evaluation in their identical declared perspective.

win_probability_change.$comment: played win probability minus reference win probability in their identical declared perspective.

mate_change.$comment: reference mate_in minus played mate_in after confirming both use the identical declared perspective; positive favors the played line when both scores have the same sign.

ranked_line_ids.$comment: Candidate rank is semantic and is deliberately not canonicalizable.

unresolved_requirements.$comment: This is operational missingness and is intentionally not canonicalizable.

confidence.$comment: Operational confidence; canonicalization must preserve it exactly.

unresolved_comparison_fact_ids.$comment: An unresolved entry is operational missingness and is intentionally not canonicalizable.

confidence.$comment: Operational confidence; canonicalization must preserve it exactly.

policy_confidence.$comment: Operational confidence; canonicalization must preserve it exactly.

rank.$comment: Rank is operational meaning and must never be canonicalized.

reason_codes.$comment: Kept in producer order because it is part of the ranking explanation.

ranked_claims.$comment: Array order and each rank value are semantic and intentionally not canonicalizable.

claim_id.$comment: The public projection materializes the admitted claim as a definition in this document.

rank.$comment: Public rank is operational meaning and must never be canonicalized.

confidence.$comment: Operational confidence; canonicalization must preserve it exactly.

public_claims.$comment: Array order and rank are public semantics and intentionally not canonicalizable.

observed_lines.$comment: Line order is retained because MultiPV/public ordering can be meaningful.
